# Spatial projection of bacteria counts (Fig 3a)
```{r}
bac_expr <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Groups_log", layer = "data")["AllBacteria", ]

coords_df <- bind_rows(lapply(Images(obj), function(img) {
  tc <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = img) %>% as.data.frame()
  if ("in_tissue" %in% colnames(tc)) tc <- tc[tc$in_tissue == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  tc %>% transmute(barcode = cell, image_name = img, x = x, y = y)
}))

plot_df_bac <- coords_df %>%
  group_by(image_name) %>%
  mutate(
    x_rot = (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9),
    y_rot = 1 - (y - min(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(y, na.rm = TRUE) - min(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    AllBacteria = bac_expr[barcode],
    image_name  = factor(image_name, levels = c(
      "CRC_03_Normal", "CRC_06_Normal", "CRC_08_Normal",
      "CRC_03_Tumor",  "CRC_07_Tumor",  "CRC_08_Tumor"
    ))
  )

ggplot(plot_df_bac, aes(x_rot, y_rot, fill = AllBacteria)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.1, color = "grey15") +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~ image_name, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text    = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.title  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(fill = "Counts\n(log1p)")
```

# Relative abundance bar plot (Fig 3b)
```{r}
count_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Probes_log", layer = "counts")

abundance_df <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(count_mat))) %>%
  rownames_to_column("spot") %>%
  mutate(sample = obj$sample[spot]) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(spot, sample), names_to = "probe", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(microbe = probe_colors[probe]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(microbe)) %>%
  group_by(sample, microbe) %>%
  summarise(total_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(rel_abundance = total_count / sum(total_count)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(abundance_df, aes(x = sample, y = rel_abundance, fill = microbe)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative Abundance", fill = "Microbe") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

# Microbial Signal QC
```{r}
# Pull data
counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")
norm   <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Spatial", layer = "data")
probes <- intersect(custom_probes, intersect(rownames(counts), rownames(norm)))
```

```{r}
# Part 1: Spot-level QC
spot_threshold <- 2

bact_counts_raw <- colSums(counts[probes, , drop = FALSE])
norm_bact <- norm[probes, , drop = FALSE]

second_highest_norm <- apply(norm_bact, 2, function(x) {
  x <- sort(as.numeric(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  x[2]
})

keep_cells <- colnames(norm)[
  (bact_counts_raw > 0) &
  (!is.na(second_highest_norm)) &
  (second_highest_norm > spot_threshold)
]

integrated_obj <- subset(obj, cells = keep_cells)
cat("Spots remaining after spot QC:", ncol(integrated_obj), "\n")

# Rebuild after subset + build matrices
counts <- GetAssayData(integrated_obj, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")
norm   <- GetAssayData(integrated_obj, assay = "Spatial", layer = "data")
probes <- intersect(custom_probes, intersect(rownames(counts), rownames(norm)))

norm_mat <- t(as.matrix(norm[probes, , drop = FALSE]))
raw_mat  <- t(as.matrix(counts[probes, , drop = FALSE]))
```

```{r}
# Part 2: Probe-level QC
probe_threshold <- 4

n_spots_per_probe <- colSums(norm_mat > spot_threshold)
keep_probes <- names(n_spots_per_probe)[n_spots_per_probe >= probe_threshold]

norm_mat <- norm_mat[, keep_probes, drop = FALSE]
raw_mat  <- raw_mat[, keep_probes, drop = FALSE]

keep_spots <- rowSums(norm_mat > spot_threshold) > 0
norm_mat   <- norm_mat[keep_spots, , drop = FALSE]
raw_mat    <- raw_mat[keep_spots, , drop = FALSE]

cat("After probe QC - spots:", nrow(norm_mat), " probes:", ncol(norm_mat), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Build Metadata
barcodes <- rownames(norm_mat)

coords <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Images(integrated_obj), function(img) {
  GetTissueCoordinates(integrated_obj, image = img)
}))
coords <- coords[barcodes, , drop = FALSE]

meta_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id           = integrated_obj$sample[barcodes],
  barcode             = barcodes,
  x                   = round(as.numeric(coords[[1]])),
  y                   = round(as.numeric(coords[[2]])),
  umi_total           = integrated_obj$nCount_Spatial[barcodes],
  bact_counts_raw     = colSums(counts[keep_probes, barcodes, drop = FALSE]),
  bact_counts_norm    = colSums(norm[keep_probes, barcodes, drop = FALSE]),
  second_highest_norm = apply(norm[keep_probes, barcodes, drop = FALSE], 2, function(x) {
    x <- sort(as.numeric(x), decreasing = TRUE)
    if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    x[2]
  }),
  sample_type         = integrated_obj$sample_type[barcodes],
  seurat_clusters     = integrated_obj$seurat_clusters[barcodes],
  stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
)

rownames(norm_mat) <- paste(meta_df$sample_id, meta_df$barcode,
                            meta_df$x, meta_df$y, sep = "_")
rownames(raw_mat)  <- rownames(norm_mat)
rownames(meta_df)  <- rownames(norm_mat)

cat("Final matrix:", nrow(norm_mat), "spots ×", ncol(norm_mat), "probes\n")
print(table(meta_df$sample_id))
```

```{r}
# Probe signal per sample (# of spots where each probe exceeds threshold)
probe_signal <- data.frame(
  probe   = colnames(norm_mat),
  n_spots = colSums(norm_mat > spot_threshold),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (sid in unique(meta_df$sample_id)) {
  idx <- meta_df$sample_id == sid
  probe_signal[[sid]] <- colSums(norm_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE] > spot_threshold)
}

probe_signal

# UMI counts per probe after QC
probe_umi_df <- data.frame(
  Name = colnames(raw_mat),
  umi  = as.numeric(colSums(raw_mat)),
  norm = as.numeric(colSums(norm_mat)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

probe_umi_df

write.csv(probe_signal, file.path(out_dir, "probe_signal.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(probe_umi_df, file.path(out_dir, "probe_umi_df.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# PCA on probes after QC
```{r}
# Transformations

norm_zscore <- norm_mat
for (sid in unique(meta_df$sample_id)) {
  idx <- meta_df$sample_id == sid
  norm_zscore[idx, ] <- scale(norm_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}
norm_zscore[is.nan(norm_zscore)] <- 0

norm_ranked <- norm_mat
for (sid in unique(meta_df$sample_id)) {
  idx <- meta_df$sample_id == sid
  mat_sub <- norm_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  norm_ranked[idx, ] <- apply(mat_sub, 2, rank, ties.method = "average")
  n_spots <- sum(idx)
  if (n_spots > 1) norm_ranked[idx, ] <- (norm_ranked[idx, ] - 1) / (n_spots - 1)
}

norm_clr <- t(apply(raw_mat, 1, function(x) {
  x <- x + 0.5
  gm <- exp(mean(log(x)))
  log(x / gm)
}))
colnames(norm_clr) <- colnames(raw_mat)

norm_clr_zscore <- norm_clr
for (sid in unique(meta_df$sample_id)) {
  idx <- meta_df$sample_id == sid
  norm_clr_zscore[idx, ] <- scale(norm_clr[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}
norm_clr_zscore[is.nan(norm_clr_zscore)] <- 0

rclr_transform <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(0, length(x))
  nz <- x > 0
  if (sum(nz) < 2) return(out)
  gm <- exp(mean(log(x[nz])))
  out[nz] <- log(x[nz] / gm)
  out
}
norm_rclr_zscore <- t(apply(raw_mat, 1, rclr_transform))
colnames(norm_rclr_zscore) <- colnames(raw_mat)
for (sid in unique(meta_df$sample_id)) {
  idx <- meta_df$sample_id == sid
  norm_rclr_zscore[idx, ] <- scale(norm_rclr_zscore[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}
norm_rclr_zscore[is.nan(norm_rclr_zscore)] <- 0
```

```{r}
# Run PCA on original and transformations

pca_original <- prcomp(t(norm_mat), scale. = TRUE)

transforms_all <- list(
  "Z-score"        = norm_zscore,
  "Rank"           = norm_ranked,
  "CLR"            = norm_clr,
  "CLR + Z-score"  = norm_clr_zscore,
  "rCLR + Z-score" = norm_rclr_zscore
)
pca_list_all <- lapply(transforms_all, function(mat) prcomp(t(mat), scale. = TRUE))
```

# Plot PCA (Fig 3c)
```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
all_genera <- sort(unique(sub("-probe.*", "", probe_map$Name[!grepl("GAPDH", probe_map$Name)])))
n_genera <- length(all_genera)
d3_colors <- pal_d3("category20")(n_genera)
group_pal <- setNames(d3_colors, all_genera)
probe_colors <- setNames(sub("-probe.*", "", colnames(norm_mat)), colnames(norm_mat))

plot_pca <- function(pca_obj, title) {
  scores  <- as.data.frame(pca_obj$x)
  var_exp <- summary(pca_obj)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    x       = scores[, 1],
    y       = scores[, 2],
    probe   = rownames(scores),
    microbe = probe_colors[rownames(scores)]
  )
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = microbe)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_pal) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
}

plot_pca_legend <- function(pca_obj) {
  scores <- as.data.frame(pca_obj$x)
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    x       = scores[, 1],
    y       = scores[, 2],
    microbe = probe_colors[rownames(scores)]
  )
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = microbe)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_pal, name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

legend_plot <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_pca_legend(pca_original))

all_pca <- c(list("Original" = pca_original), pca_list_all)
plots <- lapply(names(all_pca), function(name) plot_pca(all_pca[[name]], name))
wrap_plots(c(plots, list(cowplot::ggdraw(legend_plot))), ncol = 3)
```

# Plot probes of interest (Fig 3d)
```{r}
bacteroides_probes <- c(
  "Bacteroides-Phocaeicola-probe9",
  "Bacteroides-Phocaeicola-probe10",
  "Bacteroides-Phocaeicola-probe12"
)
porphyromonas_probes <- c(
  "Porphyromonas-probe1",
  "Porphyromonas-probe3",
  "Porphyromonas-probe4"
)

expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Probes_log", layer = "data")

coords_df <- bind_rows(lapply(Images(obj), function(img) {
  tc <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = img) %>% as.data.frame()
  if ("in_tissue" %in% colnames(tc)) tc <- tc[tc$in_tissue == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  tc %>% transmute(barcode = cell, image_name = img, x = x, y = y)
}))

base_df <- coords_df %>%
  left_join(
    obj@meta.data %>%
      rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
      select(barcode, sample),
    by = "barcode"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample %in% c("DLS CRC 08 Normal", "DLS CRC 08 Tumor")) %>%
  group_by(image_name) %>%
  mutate(
    x = (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9),
    y = (y - min(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(y, na.rm = TRUE) - min(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9),
    x_rot = x,
    y_rot = 1 - y
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
make_expr_plot_vertical <- function(probes, title) {
  expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(expr_mat[probes, , drop = FALSE]))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("barcode")
  
  plot_df <- base_df %>%
    left_join(expr_df, by = "barcode") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(probes), names_to = "probe", values_to = "expression") %>%
    mutate(probe = factor(probe, levels = probes))
  
  make_col <- function(samp, show_legend) {
    ggplot(filter(plot_df, sample == samp), aes(x_rot, y_rot, fill = expression)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.1, color = "grey15") +
      coord_fixed() +
      facet_wrap(~ probe, ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Counts (log1p)") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.title            = element_blank(),
        axis.text             = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks            = element_blank(),
        axis.line             = element_blank(),
        strip.background      = element_blank(),
        strip.text            = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing         = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.position       = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
        legend.direction      = "horizontal",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.title          = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text           = element_text(size = 12)
      )
  }
  
  (make_col("DLS CRC 08 Normal", FALSE) | make_col("DLS CRC 08 Tumor", TRUE)) +
    plot_annotation(title = title)
}

make_expr_plot_vertical(bacteroides_probes,   "Bacteroides — CRC 08")
make_expr_plot_vertical(porphyromonas_probes, "Porphyromonas — CRC 08")
```

# Heatmap contour plots (Fig 3e)
```{r}
expr_mat_raw <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Probes_log", layer = "counts")

expr_df <- data.frame(
  barcode       = colnames(expr_mat_raw),
  Bacteroides   = log1p(as.numeric(colSums(expr_mat_raw[bacteroides_probes,   , drop = FALSE]))),
  Porphyromonas = log1p(as.numeric(colSums(expr_mat_raw[porphyromonas_probes, , drop = FALSE])))
)

img_use <- "CRC_08_Tumor"

tc <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = img_use) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    barcode = cell,
    x = (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x) + 1e-9),
    y = 1 - (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y) + 1e-9)
  )

plot_df <- tc %>% left_join(expr_df, by = "barcode")

weighted_expand <- function(df, col, scale = 10) {
  df %>%
    mutate(n_rep = pmax(1, round(.data[[col]] * scale))) %>%
    filter(.data[[col]] > 0) %>%
    slice(rep(seq_len(n()), times = n_rep)) %>%
    select(-n_rep)
}

bact_expanded  <- weighted_expand(plot_df %>% filter(Bacteroides   > 2), "Bacteroides",   scale = 10)
porph_expanded <- weighted_expand(plot_df %>% filter(Porphyromonas > 2), "Porphyromonas", scale = 10)

shared_max <- max(plot_df$Bacteroides, plot_df$Porphyromonas, na.rm = TRUE)
shared_min <- min(plot_df$Bacteroides, plot_df$Porphyromonas, na.rm = TRUE)
```
